selection_policy.promotion_gate: A model is promoted only after a fixed task-set run, route identity capture, recurring zero-price verification, blind rubric scoring, and a comparable retest.

candidates.note: Claude Code public docs and workflow patterns can be studied. Actual Claude model inference generally requires authorized Anthropic access or a separately verified eligible route; public docs do not mean free weights or unrestricted free inference.
Choose exact checkpoint and license per model card; measure hardware fit and benchmark locally before promoting.

candidates.access: Apache-2.0 model card; local inference or separately verified hosted route
candidates.deployment_note: High-capability coding candidate, but repository weight size and serving requirements are substantial. Do not select before checking available RAM/VRAM, quantization, serving stack, and measured latency on the actual machine.

candidates.access: Apache-2.0 model card; local inference or separately verified hosted route
candidates.deployment_note: Smaller than Qwen3-Coder-Next but still a substantial local download. Verify exact checkpoint files, quantization, RAM/VRAM, and serving compatibility before choosing.

candidates.note: Do not conflate open-weight releases with free hosted inference. Verify exact checkpoint license, hardware requirements, and safety behavior.
Review the exact Gemma terms before redistribution or commercial use; do not label it OSI-open-source without qualification.
Compute, electricity, storage, and hardware opportunity cost still exist. Quality depends on the selected checkpoint.
A gateway is not itself a model and does not make all upstream routes free, safe, available, or equally strong.

candidates.access: Model-card-specific license; local inference or separately verified hosted route
candidates.note: More practical local reasoning candidate than full DeepSeek-R1 for some hardware profiles. Verify current model-card license, memory requirements, and actual hardware before deployment.

candidates.access: MIT model card; local inference or separately verified hosted route
candidates.note: Compact reasoning candidate to benchmark against larger models on math, structured tasks, and instruction following. Confirm memory fit and test actual workload.

candidates.access: Apache-2.0 model card; local inference or separately verified hosted route
candidates.note: Multilingual and multimodal-capable candidate; verify vision path, hardware fit, and task-specific quality before promotion.

candidates.access: Llama 3.3 Community License; local inference or separately verified hosted route
candidates.note: Potential synthesis candidate, but the custom community license is not Apache/MIT; review eligibility and redistribution terms. Large local hardware footprint.

candidates.access: Gemma Terms of Use; local inference or separately verified hosted route
candidates.note: Potential multimodal candidate. Gemma-specific terms apply; do not describe as unrestricted OSI open-source. Verify exact hardware and image-task needs.
